shared_elements: upright anthropomorphic/standing figure or body schema
repeated small signs or ornaments on a vertical surface
justification: The strongest shared content is that both present an upright anthropomorphic form on a vertical decorated surface, associated with hands/waist details and surrounded or overlaid with smaller animal and sign-like motifs, including profile animals and curving forms. The major difference is that A is dominated by a highly detailed frontal human figure with elaborate headdress, ornaments, and attendants, whereas B is a much more schematic sign-and-animal arrangement on a T-shaped body with no comparable face, headdress, costume, or narrative figure group.
